patches.notes: Install (PC): Download the patch from the link below. Once you have downloaded the file, locate the steam directory for the game (right click on the game in Steam, Properties, Local Files, Browse Local Files...). To apply the patch, copy the 'game' folder (from within the 'uncensored' folder in the archive) to the game install directory mentioned above.
